inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer count of answered scheduled surveys per participant.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant who answered fewer than eight surveys and retain a participant who answered at least eight; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not identify, validate, or deduplicate answered surveys or derive the participant-level count.
The 40 scheduled surveys and the stated 20% basis are source context; this binding executes the disclosed integer boundary of eight and does not reconstruct the schedule.
Complete logging and survey data are a separate upstream eligibility condition.
The separately excluded participant who received 69 non-duplicate surveys is not represented by this count gate.
Android recruitment eligibility is separate from this answered-survey count.
A missing participant count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
